delegation_format: aps:authority-delegation:v1 chain (agent-passport-system 8.0.1), scope grants in ot-scope/v1
claim_ceiling: Decides only the delegation side of the authority-fixture contract: the APS chain is valid at the call's decision_time and its leaf grants the call's building, asset, parameter and operation. It does not check the value, the unit or the work order, and a pass never authorizes a control action. Keys are test-only and derived from public labels. Revocation is not exercised: every member is treated as active.
